{{Top|canon=Dagoyan Order}}
[[File:Mountain_Meditation_FDNP.png|thumb|right|300px|Dagoyan Masters meditate with a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Force-sensitive at the [[Halsoun Dagoyan Monastery]]]]
The '''Dagoyan Masters''' were a group that were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong in the Force]] on [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]]. Unlike the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], they were not warriors. Rather, they focused on knowledge, intuition and the harmony of the universe, using their ability in a pacifist manner.

The Dagoyan labeled the Jedi "kidnappers" when a group of [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] children were inducted into the Order, believing the Jedi had done so against the children's will.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] kidnapped the Dagoyan Masters to sacrifice their Force energy, encasing it in a container to let it flow that was designed for their Great Mother. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] (seeing a vision of the [[Witch/Legends|Witch]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]) called [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] for assistance, with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] being accompanied by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to thwart the plan. The mission was a success and lead to an improved relationship between Bardotta and the Jedi.
